verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents Teams, where you create a team, invite members, and assign them roles. It also documents scoped API keys with limited permissions via `vastai create api-key` for CI/CD and shared tooling, and teams hold their own credit pool funded by transfer. That covers the core of the story, but the documentation is thin, so this rests on the outcome clause being met by roles plus scoped keys. Missing for 10: details of which roles exist and what each permits, explicit per-member or per-key spend limits and budget caps, and independent or hands-on corroboration of team and key governance.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can manage team members with roles and scoped API keys so credentials and spend stay controlled

citations.quote: This quickstart guide will walk you through how to create a team, invite new team members and assign them to different roles.
You can also create scoped keys with limited permissions using `vastai create api-key`, useful for CI/CD or shared tooling.
For shared tooling, CI/CD, or automation, create a scoped key with only the permissions that workload needs.
To add credit during team creation, select Transfer my personal credits checkbox, enter an amount, and then click Create.
